tools.name: list_tenants
tools.summary: Lists the Busymate workspaces the signed-in user belongs to.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads data only; it creates, changes or deletes nothing and sends nothing.
justifications.destructiveHint: Read-only; nothing can be deleted or overwritten.
justifications.openWorldHint: Reads only the signed-in user's own Busymate workspace, a bounded private account.

tools.verify: Confirm the handler has no side effects beyond the summary (including analytics or log rows) before freezing.
